behavior: `--transform-origin` is in the pixels of the popup, from its border box: the arrow or the aligned edge or the center of the anchor, on the edge of the anchor. A margin of the popup, a padding of the positioner, a margin that collapses through the popup and a `zoom` of the popup do not move it. A Select popup over the trigger grows from the text of the selected item after its place. In the Popover demo of Base UI, a 16 px margin on the popup moves the origin 16 px off the edge of the trigger.
